THE OPPORTUNITY

Acquire control of a landmark property ready for a new vision.

A proposed sale of an aggregate 73% of the issued share capital and voting rights of a legally existing Greek hotel and tourism société anonyme whose commercial operations are currently inactive. The company owns a substantial hotel property at 109 Thermopylon Street in Sparta, Laconia.

The hotel is presently closed and in a significantly deteriorated condition. A substantial renovation and modernization program will be required. A new investor may restore and reopen it as a hotel or consider apartments, serviced residences, senior living or care accommodation, wellness, education, offices, mixed-use development or another legally permissible concept.

The company’s Articles of Association permit the transfer of the shares. Completion remains subject to customary legal, corporate, financial and technical due diligence.

CURRENT CONDITION

The property requires major restoration

The building is currently in a dilapidated and significantly deteriorated state after a prolonged period of non-operation. It requires substantial cleaning, repair, replacement of systems, refurbishment and overall capital investment.

The photographs shown on this website are archival images from the property’s prior period of operation, believed to date from around 2021, and they do not reflect the property’s present physical condition.

REASON FOR PROPOSED SALE

An orderly transfer to a capable strategic investor

The hotel ceased operations in March 2021 during the COVID-19 period, following a substantial decline in hospitality activity. The company remains legally constituted and has not been dissolved, while its commercial operations have remained inactive since the closure. Longstanding differences among shareholders regarding management, investment and the future direction of the property delayed its reopening. The controlling shareholders are now seeking an orderly transfer of the 73% controlling interest to a strategic investor capable of recapitalizing, restoring and reopening the hotel or pursuing another legally permissible development concept.

RESIDENTIAL & RESIDENCY-PERMIT POTENTIAL

A possible apartment-conversion opportunity

A purchaser may explore conversion of all or part of the property into apartments or investment residences. A properly structured conversion may create an opportunity to serve international purchasers interested in Greece’s property-based residence programs.

The most suitable structure, permitted uses, separate titles and residence-program pathway can be developed during the purchaser’s legal and technical planning process.
